Resolves #22046
Related: #20682, #20971, #20987

Prevents the three `.portal-door-command` chips in `Portal.view.home.parts.AudienceDoors` (`#/home` Screen 2) from clipping at phone widths (`<= 840 px`): `@media (max-width: 840px) .portal-glass-card` sets `.portal-door-command` padding (`0.4rem 0.55rem`) and `code { font-size: clamp(0.66rem, 3vw, 0.75rem); line-height: 1.4; overflow-wrap: break-word; white-space: normal; }`, keeping all three command strings on one unclipped line at `390 × 844` and `360 × 800` while wrapping cleanly under browser zoom.

Evidence: L3 (`HomeAudienceDoorsNL.spec.mjs` local Neural Link run, `8/8` across `1440 × 900`, `900 × 700`, `646 × 844`, `390 × 844`, and `360 × 800`, plus `390 × 844` / `360 × 800` frames below) → L3 required (AC-1 through AC-3).

Micro-review eligible: config-leaf — bounded `@media (max-width: 840px)` CSS rule on `.portal-door-command` plus matching `scrollWidth <= clientWidth + 1` Playwright assertion, zero JS/copy changes.

agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline PR baseline, Commit authorship ran.

## Deltas from ticket

- Used fluid `font-size: clamp(0.66rem, 3vw, 0.75rem)` with `overflow-wrap: break-word` instead of a fixed `0.8rem` wrap so `"neo-agent-brain · neo-agent-institution"` (`39` chars) stays on one unbroken `38 px` line at both `390 × 844` (`303 / 303 px`) and `360 × 800` (`273 / 273 px`) instead of splitting `neo-agent-` / `institution` at the hyphen, while still wrapping under browser text zoom; updated `#22046` in place to match.

## Test Evidence

Hosted Engine Tests exclude `HomeAudienceDoorsNL.spec.mjs` when `NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT` is unset. The geometry evidence below comes from the local Neural Link run.

- **Red-on-`dev` (`3f01b65ae4`) → green-on-head (`1f076bf691`):** `NEO_NL_PORT=18089 NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT=../neo-agent-brain npm run test-e2e -- test/playwright/e2e/portal/HomeAudienceDoorsNL.spec.mjs` failed on `dev` (`HomeAudienceDoorsNL.spec.mjs:361:15`, `scrollWidth: 342 > clientWidth: 303` at `390 × 844` and `342 > 273` at `360 × 800`) and passed **`8/8`** (`26.6s`) after `npm run build-themes -- -n -e dev -t all`; `AudienceDoors.spec.mjs` passed **`4/4`**.

| Viewport | Before (`dev` `3f01b65ae4`) | After (`head` `1f076bf691`) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `390 × 844` (`#/home` AudienceDoors) | ![Before 390x844 on dev](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/4ee3c205167384c28cbe9eddd07d8d87de99cdab/review-evidence/22046/doors-dev-390x844.png?raw=true) | ![After 390x844 on head](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/4ee3c205167384c28cbe9eddd07d8d87de99cdab/review-evidence/22046/doors-head-390x844.png?raw=true) |
| `360 × 800` (`#/home` AudienceDoors) | ![Before 360x800 on dev](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/4ee3c205167384c28cbe9eddd07d8d87de99cdab/review-evidence/22046/doors-dev-360x800.png?raw=true) | ![After 360x800 on head](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/4ee3c205167384c28cbe9eddd07d8d87de99cdab/review-evidence/22046/doors-head-360x800.png?raw=true) |

Frame critique: on `dev`, the `Run an agent team` command chip clipped `"neo-agent-brain · neo-agent-institut"` at `390 × 844` and `"neo-agent-brain · neo-agent-inst"` at `360 × 800`; on `1f076bf691`, the full `"neo-agent-brain · neo-agent-institution"` string fits on one centered single line at both widths with matching horizontal padding. In both frames, scrolling Door 2 to the center of the phone viewport leaves the bottom of Door 1 and top of Door 3 partially visible behind the translucent sticky Portal header / lower viewport fold, which is expected free-scroll phone behavior (`scroll-snap-align: unset` at `<= 840 px`).
